details: Batch for Tue Nov 24 sent, waiting for approval
summary: 16 of the 35 reels from the last 7 days (Nov 17 to 23) have numbers; the other 19 show 0 to 2 views, and every one of those is a book that had already run earlier in this format. The 16 counted reels drew 5,774 views in total, typically about 208 each. They held 17.6% of viewers past 3 seconds, down from 24.3% the week before (35 reels, 14,892 views). In the current block, O5 (the edition line: language, binding, publisher) is at 19.2% and O1 (the number line) at 17.8%, a 1.4-point lead for O5, but each rests on a single reel and O5 has only 148 views, too few to mean anything. Best recent reel: The Explanation of an-Nawawi's Forty Hadith on Nov 17, 23.5%. Worst: Sharh Kashf ash-Shubuhat on Nov 17, 8.1%. Today's batch gives O5 a third day on three books that have not run in this format before, against O1 on two books that have.
change: No winner yet in block 4: O5 (edition line over the book) has only 148 views, under the 500 needed, so the block runs a third day and every later date moves back one day. Yesterday's repeat books drew 150 views against 1,133 the day before, so today uses five different books. Block 3 is final: O1 (number line) 16.7% and O4 (author line) 16.5%, a tie, so O1 stays and nothing in the formula changes. Next block tests O6, which opens on the spine and turns to the cover, on Nov 25 and 26.
